== Examples ==
<pre>
*{{token|ATTACK|am}}
*{{token|ARMORLEVEL|ar}}
*{{token|SPEED|c}}
*{{token|MANNERISM_EYES}}
*{{token|NAME|c|cat:cats:cat}}
*{{token|}}
</pre>

*{{token|ATTACK|am}} (ammo)
*{{token|ARMORLEVEL|ar}} (armor)
*{{token|SPEED|c}} (creature)
*{{token|MANNERISM_EYES}} (token type not defined, guesses mannerism)
*{{token|NAME|c|cat:cats:cat}}
*{{token|}}
